FYP
EF-wy-PEE
abbreviation (Gen-Z slang)
Abbreviation of For You page, TikTok’s main feed, which became the app’s front door after TikTok absorbed Musical.ly in 2018. Unlike older feeds built from accounts a user chose to follow, the For You page is filled by a recommendation algorithm that studies what each user watches, pauses on, and replays. Users tag posts "#fyp" in hope of landing there, and "it was on my FYP" means "the app showed it to me."

Definition · Webster 1828 · Scriptures · Corruption · Roots · Usage · Related

Biblical Definition

In current slang the FYP is TikTok’s For You page, the endless feed the app picks for each user; to say a video "came up on my FYP" is to say the algorithm chose it. Teens speak of their FYP as a kind of mirror: "my FYP knows me too well." The Christian observation: the name is the sermon. A feed built "for you" is built from your own appetites, and it learns them faster than you do. Paul warned of a time when men "after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears" (2Ti 4:3); the FYP is that heap, delivered by machine. Scripture puts the guarding of the heart on us, not on the app: "Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life" (Pro 4:23). David made a vow every phone owner could copy: "I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes" (Psa 101:3). Christ said that what we look at fills us: "The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light" (Mat 6:22). And Paul gives the better curation: "whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest" — "think on these things" (Php 4:8). A father tells his son: the FYP is not really for you; it is for the advertisers, built from your weakest moments. Train it if you must, limit it always, and spend more hours in the pages that really were written for you — the Word of God, which knows your heart better than any algorithm and loves you more.

Webster 1828 Definition

Gen-Z abbreviation (TikTok, c. 2018–present) for the For You page, the algorithm-picked feed — a heap of teachers for itching ears, set against the heart Scripture tells us to keep.

FYP, abbr. (Gen-Z slang, c. 2018–present; TikTok) For You page: the app’s main feed of videos chosen by its recommendation algorithm. "This came up on my FYP and I can’t stop watching it."

#fyp, #foryou, #foryoupage — hashtags added in hope of reaching the feed; my FYP, one’s personal feed, often spoken of as if it knew the user’s mind.

Older relatives: the newspaper front page, the evening news, the radio playlist — chosen by editors for everyone, not by a machine for one.

Webster (1828), root word page: “PAGE, noun [&hellip;] One side of a leaf of a book. 1. A book or writing or writings; as the page of history. 2. Pages, in the plural, signifies also books or writings; as the sacred pages.”

Decode for parents: your child’s FYP is a map of what holds his attention; it is worth asking, gently, to see it.

Key Scripture

2Ti 4:3 — "For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;"

Pro 4:23 — "Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life."

Psa 101:3 — "I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me."

Mat 6:22 — "The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light."

Php 4:8 — "Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things."

Modern Corruption

The FYP serves each user a feed built from his own appetites, so that the heart is curated by a machine that profits from its weakest moments.

expand to see more

Every age had its distractions, but they came in common: the same paper, the same broadcast, the same town square. The For You page is a feed of one, assembled by studying where your thumb pauses and tuned to keep you there. It is men heaping "to themselves teachers, having itching ears" (2Ti 4:3) without even the effort of the heaping. It learns the boy’s anger, the girl’s insecurity, and the lonely night hours, and serves more of each.

Scripture never lets the eye off the hook: "I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes" (Psa 101:3) is a vow, and vows are made by people, not by apps. "Keep thy heart with all diligence" (Pro 4:23). Teach your children that the feed is neither neutral nor their friend, that a single eye fills the body with light (Mat 6:22), and that the curation God commends is Philippians 4:8. Then set the example: put down your own phone at the table.

Greek & Hebrew Roots

For You page → TikTok’s algorithmic main feed (2018) → #fyp, the hashtag → my FYP, one’s personal feed.
